items.title: UK police launch murder investigation after death of former minister
items.description: The 78-year-old, who found fame as a Strictly Come Dancing contestant when she left office, was found dead at her home having sustained serious injuries.

items.title: 'Incredible musician': Cold Chisel saxophonist Andy Bickers dies from cancer
items.description: Cold Chisel saxophone player Andy Bickers has died after "hard fought battle with cancer", the band has announced.

items.title: Secret Service reportedly urged Trump to leave Türkiye on old Air Force One
items.description: Officials reportedly urged the US president to swap out his Qatari-donated luxury jet as a security precaution due to renewed hostilities with Iran.

items.title: China achieves first-ever controlled rocket recovery
items.description: China has successfully tested an experimental rocket retrieval system, state media reported, in the hope of breaking US dominance in reusable rockets.

items.title: Pies win a thriller against Kangaroos as veteran faces MRO scrutiny
items.description: Collingwood wins a thriller against North Melbourne after a last ditch kick from the Roos hits the turf.

items.title: Derryn Hinch remembered as 'tough old bugger', 'crusader for justice'
items.description: Media identity Derryn Hinch is being remembered as a provocative but courageous journalist who was ahead of his time in his fight against institutional sex abuse.

items.title: Economist Justin Wolfers on the 'absurdity' of Trump's America
items.description: Former Reserve Bank economist Justin Wolfers says Australia urgently needs to consider the role of money in its politics while examining how US President Donald Trump profits from his position.

items.title: Teenager arrested after remains found during search for missing 13-year-old girl
items.description: Detectives are investigating after human remains were found during a search for a missing teenage girl in Victoria's west.

items.title: First native bird found with H5 bird flu, marking 'devastating' new reality
items.description: CSIRO lab testing has confirmed the detection of H5 bird flu in a greater crested tern — the first time the strain has been detected in an Australian seabird, after previous confirmed cases involved migratory birds from the sub-Antarctic region.

items.title: Telstra's returning CEO Vicki Brady 'deeply sorry' for national outage
items.description: Telstra chief executive Vicki Brady apologises to the company's customers, saying the telco let them down and that investigations into the cause of Wednesday's Telstra outage are continuing.

items.title: President Trump Announces U.S. Military Airstrike in Venezuela
items.description: President Trump states the U.S. military conducted its first known airstrike inside Venezuela targeting a dock where drugs were allegedly loaded onto boats[1][2][4].

items.title: Trump Meets Netanyahu at Mar-a-Lago for Gaza Ceasefire Phase Two Talks
items.description: President Trump met with Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu to discuss advancing phase two of the Gaza ceasefire, including reconstruction and responses to Iran[1][4].

items.title: Feds Launch Massive Taxpayer Fraud Probe in Minnesota After Viral Video
items.description: Federal agencies including DHS, FBI, and ICE investigate $110 million in suspected fraud at Minnesota child care centers following a viral YouTube video[3].

items.title: Americans Express Widespread Opposition to AI Data Centers
items.description: Public backlash against AI infrastructure data centers grows, with protests and demands for bans influencing Democratic Party strategies for future elections[3].

items.title: Elon Musk's Humanoid Robot Vision: China Poised to Lead Production
items.description: China prioritizes humanoid robots in tech race with U.S., ramping up production while warning of industry bubble and potential bottlenecks[3].

items.title: Trump-Putin Call Amid Ukraine-Russia Tensions Over Peace Plan
items.description: President Trump spoke with Putin amid ongoing Ukraine conflict, with Russia reevaluating peace plan tenets after Ukrainian denials[1].

items.title: Democratic Gubernatorial Candidates in Wisconsin Focus on Inflation and Trump
items.description: Seven Democrats vying for Wisconsin governor blame economic issues on Trump and emphasize affordability ahead of 2026 primary[3].
